summary: Morgan muted Vic. Vic's evidence-backed finding must reach an unmuted reader as substance and must never reach Morgan on any unasked surface — prompt hint or tripwire. The unmuted probe is the control that proves the muted silences are silent for the right reason. Covers Vic's OWN tree only: a muted author's claim inside an unmuted teammate's tree (claims-level notMutedCondition) is pinned by packages/server/test/mute.test.ts, not this corpus.

probes.prompt: does anything mangle the http header on ingress
probes.rationale: DEBATABLE BY DESIGN: the prompt shares exactly ONE mid-frequency word (header) with one claim body, and that single OR-joined FTS token qualifies the context as a provable lexical match, so the evidence-backed root cause arrives as full substance. Today's precision floor is tier membership alone — no matched-token minimum, no rank floor. Recorded as today's behavior, not endorsed: building this corpus surfaced the same single-token path delivering cross-domain noise (key, across, retries), and hint_deliveries telemetry decides whether substance should demand more than one shared word.
